A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], '''Grahuur''' was a [[Big game hunter/Legends|hunter]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Grahuur had a camp in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
While on Nal Hutta, Grahuur was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in combat at his camp by an individual who was affiliated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

Grahuur had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]], dark-colored skin, and light-blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. During his time at his camp on Nal Hutta, Grahuur wore a dull-green-colored [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] and a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]]. He was armed with a wrist-mounted [[Knife/Legends|blade]] as well as a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] equipped with both a [[Scope/Legends|scope]] and a [[Laser sighting unit|laser sight]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grahuur first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]]. In the game, he appears as a lower-level boss on Nal Hutta&mdash;known in-game as Hutta&mdash;the starting planet for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agent]] classes. However, any Imperial player class&mdash;[[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], [[Cipher Nine|Imperial agent]], [[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]], or [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]&mdash;can kill Grahuur, and the Wookiee's death is one of the required kills for completing the "Hutta's Most Wanted" achievement. While the achievement is not required to continue with any of the main storylines,<ref name="HMW">{{TORcite|Achievement: Hutta's Most Wanted on Hutta}}</ref> this article is written with the assumption of 100 percent game completion.
